exclusions.source_text: Karnofsky ≥ 70% for participants ≥ 16 years of age.
Lansky ≥ 70% for participants \< 16 years of age.
Estimated glomerular filtration rate based on Modification of Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) calculation ≥ 30 mL/min/1.73 m\^2 for participants ≥ 18 years of age.
estimated glomerular filtration rate based on Schwartz (2009) calculation ≥ 30 mL/min/1.73 m\^2 for participants \< 18 years of age.
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN) (or ≤ 5 x ULN for participants with liver metastases).
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤ 3 x ULN (≤ 5 x ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin (TBL) ≤ 1.5 x ULN (unless related to Gilbert's or Meulengracht disease).
Left ventricular ejection fraction ≥ 50%. If left ventricular ejection fraction cannot be measured, then left ventricular fractional shortening ≥ 28%.
Untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases or leptomeningeal disease.

History of other malignancy within the past 2 years, except for malignancy treated with curative intent with low risk for recurrence (approximately \< 10%) and with no known active disease present for \>1 year before enrollment.
Participants with Type 1 diabetes, vitiligo, psoriasis, hypo- or hyper-thyroid disease not requiring immunosuppressive treatment are permitted.

Currently pregnant (confirmed with positive pregnancy test) or breastfeeding or planning to become pregnant, donate eggs, or breastfeed while on trial until an additional 6 months after the last dose of trial intervention.
